desc: Implement `count_up_to(x)` using exact-length digit DPs and a tight bound for the maximum length.
Enumerate all possible target digit sums and track product modulo each target sum.
Handle zero digits, leading-digit restrictions, sum-reachability pruning, and range subtraction.
Run supplied examples, brute-force small-range differential tests, and a worst-case performance check; report explicit pass/fail results.
